heading.en: Origins and years as a deputy

body.zh-Hant: 克里蒙梭1841年9月28日生於旺代的穆耶龍－昂－帕雷，1867年取得醫學博士學位，在巴黎第18區開業行醫；帝國末年他回到巴黎，9月4日之後以蒙馬特區長的身分進入公共生活。1871年2月8日他當選塞納省代表，之後長期擔任下議院議員，先代表塞納（1876至1885年），1885年起代表瓦爾省。1893年巴拿馬醜聞的風波中，他在瓦爾省以8610票對9503票敗給對手，眾議員生涯就此中斷。
body.en: Clemenceau was born on 28 September 1841 at Mouilleron-en-Pareds in the Vendée, took his doctorate in 1867 and practised medicine in the 18th arrondissement. He returned to Paris towards the end of the Empire and, after 4 September, entered public life as mayor of Montmartre; on 8 February 1871 he was elected a representative of the Seine. He then sat as a deputy, first for the Seine (1876-1885) and from 1885 for the Var. In 1893, in the climate of the Panama scandal, he lost his Var seat by 8,610 votes to 9,503.

heading.zh-Hant: 報人、德雷福斯事件與當選參議員
heading.en: Journalism, the Dreyfus Affair and the Senate

body.zh-Hant: 落選後克里蒙梭轉為記者，1893年10月3日在《正義報》發表第一篇文章；1897年10月起任《曙光報》社論作者。德雷福斯事件中，左拉1898年1月12日的文章標題「我控訴」即由他選定。1902年4月6日，他在瓦爾省參議員補選的第一輪投票中當選，得344票對122票，此後任參議員至1920年。
body.en: After his defeat Clemenceau turned to journalism, publishing his first article in La Justice on 3 October 1893 and becoming the leading editorialist of L'Aurore in October 1897. During the Dreyfus Affair he chose the title "J'accuse" for Zola's article of 12 January 1898. On 6 April 1902 he was elected senator for the Var on the first ballot, by 344 votes to 122, and he sat in the Senate until 1920.

heading.zh-Hant: 內政部長與第一次組閣

body.zh-Hant: 1906年3月14日克里蒙梭出任內政部長，至10月19日；10月25日起以內閣總理兼任內政部長，直到1909年7月20日。任內他創設勞動部；1907年起對外局勢惡化，卡薩布蘭卡發生歐洲工人遭殺害事件後，他隨即下令利奧泰占領該城。1909年1月3日他在參議員改選中連任；同年7月20日德爾卡塞就海軍重整一事在眾議院質詢他，最終202名議員投票反對，內閣倒台。
body.en: On 14 March 1906 Clemenceau became Minister of the Interior, a post he held until 19 October; from 25 October 1906 until 20 July 1909 he was head of government while remaining Interior Minister. His government created a Ministry of Labour, and when, amid the external difficulties that began in 1907, European workers were killed at Casablanca, he at once ordered Lyautey to occupy the city. Re-elected senator on 3 January 1909, he was challenged in the Chamber on 20 July 1909 by Delcassé over the reorganisation of the navy, and 202 deputies voted against his ministry.

heading.zh-Hant: 一戰、參議院軍事委員會與戰時內閣
heading.en: The Great War, the Senate army commission and the wartime cabinet

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月3日戰爭爆發。克里蒙梭嚴厲批評最高統帥部的作戰方法，報紙因此被查禁，他便把《自由人報》改名為《被縛的人》；在參議院他擔任陸軍委員會主席。1917年11月他第二度組閣，總理兼任陸軍部長，11月19日向眾議院提出只有「作戰」一詞的施政綱領。1918年3月26日在杜朗，兩國軍方負責人同意把全部部隊交由福煦指揮；11月11日簽訂停戰。
body.en: The war broke out on 3 August 1914. Clemenceau judged the methods of the high command so severely that his paper was banned, and he renamed L'Homme libre as L'Homme enchaîné; in the Senate he chaired the army commission. In November 1917 he formed his second ministry, as head of government and Minister of War, presenting it to the Chamber on 19 November with a programme summed up as "to wage war". At Doullens on 26 March 1918 the military leaders of the two countries agreed to place all troops under Foch, and the armistice was signed on 11 November.

heading.en: Peace conference, resignation and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1918年11月21日，法蘭西學術院在座院士一致選克里蒙梭為院士，福煦也同樣獲選，但他始終未正式入院。1919年1月18日巴黎和會開幕，他被推為會議主席；6月28日和約在凡爾賽鏡廳簽字。1920年1月16日總統預備會議中他以389票對408票輸給德沙內爾，隨即撤回參選；他的總理與陸軍部長任期至1920年1月18日結束，參議員任期則已於1920年1月10日屆滿，他未再競選。1929年11月24日他去世。
body.en: On 21 November 1918 the sitting members of the Académie française elected Clemenceau unanimously, as they had just done for Foch, though he was never received into it. The Peace Conference opened on 18 January 1919 with Clemenceau elected its president, and on 28 June the treaty was signed in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles. At the preparatory meeting of 16 January 1920 he lost the presidential vote to Deschanel, 389 to 408, and withdrew; his term as head of government and Minister of War ended on 18 January 1920, his Senate mandate having ended on 10 January 1920 when he did not stand again. He died on 24 November 1929.

body.zh-Hant: 佛朗哥1892年12月4日生於加利西亞的費羅爾。德國國家圖書館人名權威檔與歷史博物館年表都記載這個生日。他後來進入托雷多步兵學院，1912年依自己的請求調往西屬摩洛哥。1926年他晉升准將，時年34歲，成為西班牙最年輕的將軍。
body.en: Francisco Franco was born on 4 December 1892 in Ferrol, Galicia; both the German National Library authority file and the German Historical Museum chronology record the date. He later entered the infantry academy at Toledo and, at his own request, was transferred to Spanish Morocco in 1912. In 1926 he was promoted to brigadier general at the age of 34, which made him the youngest general in Spain.

body.zh-Hant: 1928年佛朗哥出任薩拉戈薩新設軍事學院（總軍官學院）的院長。丹麥Lex百科與德國歷史博物館年表都把起點定在1928年，西班牙陸軍官方的學院沿革則記載他任職到1931年學院第二度解散為止。
body.en: In 1928 Franco became director of the newly created military academy at Zaragoza, the General Military Academy. The Danish Lex encyclopedia and the German Historical Museum chronology both place the start in 1928, while the Spanish Army's official history of the academy records that he held the post until the academy was dissolved for the second time in 1931.

body.zh-Hant: 1934年佛朗哥在右翼政府任內領導鎮壓阿斯圖里亞斯工人起義，並動用摩洛哥部隊。1935年右翼政府任命他為總參謀長，5月他回到馬德里就任。1936年2月，剛上台的人民陣線政府撤換他的參謀長職務，改派他任加那利群島軍事司令；2月23日出版的《馬德里公報》刊載2月21日簽署的任命法令，文中稱他是當時的陸軍中央參謀長。
body.en: In 1934 Franco led the suppression of the Asturian workers' uprising under the right-wing government, using Moroccan troops. In 1935 that government made him chief of the general staff, and in May he returned to Madrid. In February 1936 the newly elected Popular Front government removed him as chief of staff and gave him the military command of the Canary Islands. The Madrid Gazette of 23 February 1936 published the appointment decree signed on 21 February, which calls him the then chief of the Army's Central General Staff.

body.zh-Hant: 1936年7月17日，原定計畫提前一天暴露，非洲軍隨即起事。佛朗哥7月18日搭包機飛往非洲，統率三萬人。7月18日簽署、19日見報的共和國政府法令，免去他加那利軍事司令的職務。
body.en: On 17 July 1936 the planned coup was uncovered a day earlier than intended and the Army of Africa rose. Franco flew to Africa by chartered plane on 18 July and took command of 30,000 men. A Republican government decree signed on 18 July and published on 19 July relieved him of the military command of the Canary Islands.

heading.en: Supreme power in the Civil War

body.zh-Hant: 1936年9月29日在布爾戈斯簽署的國防委員會法令，任命師級將軍佛朗哥為「西班牙國家政府首長」，由他承擔新國家的全部權力；同一法令也任命他為陸海空國民軍總司令（Generalísimo），並授予作戰各軍總司令一職。10月1日在布爾戈斯，他被選為總司令與西班牙國家首長，唯一的反對票來自卡瓦內利亞斯（Cabanellas）。
body.en: A decree of the Defence Junta signed at Burgos on 29 September 1936 named Major General Franco Head of the Government of the Spanish State, with him assuming all the powers of the new State; the same decree named him Generalísimo of the national land, sea and air forces and gave him the post of General Commander of the Armies of operations. On 1 October at Burgos he was chosen generalísimo and head of the Spanish state, with Cabanellas the only vote against.

heading.zh-Hant: 長槍黨領袖與元首身分
heading.en: Party leader and head of state

body.zh-Hant: 1937年4月，佛朗哥成為長槍黨（Falange）的領袖，並把它與天主教與保守團體合併，成為唯一被允許的政黨。1938年1月31日的官報刊載中央行政組織法，規定政府主席職務歸屬國家元首。1938年7月18日的官報法令稱他為國家元首、陸海空軍總司令與全國長槍黨領袖（Jefe Nacional de FET y de las JONS）。
body.en: In April 1937 Franco became leader of the Falange, which he merged with Catholic and conservative groups into the only permitted party. A law on the central administration, published in the Official State Gazette of 31 January 1938, made the presidency of the government attached to the head of state. A decree published in the Official State Gazette of 18 July 1938 calls him head of state, Generalísimo of the armies of land, sea and air, and National Chief of the FET y de las JONS.

body.zh-Hant: 挪威Store norske leksikon寫道，佛朗哥在1939年4月1日領導起義軍贏得內戰。1939年8月8日的法律修改中央行政組織，前言稱需要國家元首「更直接、更個人化」地參與政府；法律廢除副主席職位，並在總司令主持下設立國防委員會（Junta de Defensa Nacional）。
body.en: Store norske leksikon states that Franco led the rebels to victory in the Civil War on 1 April 1939. The law of 8 August 1939 modified the central administration; its preamble calls for a more direct and personal action of the head of state in the government. The law abolished the vice-presidency of the government and created a National Defence Junta under the presidency of the Generalísimo.

heading.zh-Hant: 西班牙議會與統治的延續
heading.en: The Cortes and continuity of rule

body.zh-Hant: 西班牙眾議院官方網站說明，西班牙議會（Cortes Españolas）的首次會議在1943年3月16日舉行。同一頁指出，佛朗哥從1939年4月建立的政權起，一直到1975年去世都是國家元首，並到1973年為止同時領導政府。
body.en: The official website of the Spanish Congress of Deputies states that the first session of the Cortes Españolas was held on 16 March 1943. The same page notes that, from the regime established in April 1939, Franco remained head of state until his death in 1975 and, until 1973, also headed the government.

people.name: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk
people.nameZh: 穆斯塔法·凱末爾·阿塔圖克

body.zh-Hant: 穆斯塔法·凱末爾1881年生於當時屬奧斯曼帝國的薩洛尼卡。1899年3月13日他進入伊斯坦堡陸軍士官學校，1902年2月10日以少尉畢業，1905年1月11日自陸軍大學畢業，授參謀上尉；1905至1907年在大馬士革第五軍服役。1909年4月19日開進伊斯坦堡的行動軍中，他擔任參謀長。
body.en: Mustafa Kemal was born in 1881 in Salonica, then a province of the Ottoman Empire. He entered the War College in Istanbul on 13 March 1899, graduated as a second lieutenant on 10 February 1902, and finished the War Academy as a staff captain on 11 January 1905. From 1905 to 1907 he served in Damascus with the Fifth Army, and on 19 April 1909 he was chief of staff of the Action Army that entered Istanbul.

heading.zh-Hant: 大戰、民族運動與大國民議會
heading.en: The Great War, the national movement and the Assembly

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰中，他1915年以第19師師長身分參加加里波利戰役；1918年9月1日回到阿勒波任第7軍團司令，10月31日改任雷霆軍團集團司令。1919年5月19日他在薩姆松登陸，同年7月8至9日夜間在電報通話中被告知官職已被免除，他則致電辭去官職與軍職。他主持了7月23日在埃爾祖魯姆、9月4日在錫瓦斯召開的代表大會。1920年4月23日大國民議會在安卡拉開始運作，他被選為議會與政府首長。
body.en: In the First World War he took part in the Gallipoli campaign in 1915 as commander of the 19th Division. On 1 September 1918 he returned to Aleppo as commander of the Seventh Army and on 31 October 1918 was given the Yıldırım Army Group. He landed at Samsun on 19 May 1919; on the night of 8-9 July 1919 he was told his official post had ended, and he resigned from his post and from the army. He presided over the congresses at Erzurum (23 July) and Sivas (4 September). The Grand National Assembly opened at Ankara on 23 April 1920, and he was elected head of the Assembly and of the Government.

heading.zh-Hant: 總司令與獨立戰爭勝利
heading.en: Commander-in-chief and victory in the War of Independence

body.zh-Hant: 薩卡里亞會戰之前，大國民議會在1921年8月5日授予他總司令（Başkomutanlık）職權；會戰獲勝後，議會於9月19日依法授予他元帥（Mareşal）軍階與「加齊」稱號。1922年8月26日土軍開始反攻，在8月30日由他指揮的總司令會戰中消滅希臘軍大部，9月9日進入伊茲密爾；10月11日簽訂穆達尼亞停戰協定。
body.en: Before the Battle of Sakarya, on 5 August 1921, the Grand National Assembly gave Mustafa Kemal the supreme command (Başkomutanlık). After the victory the Assembly, by law on 19 September 1921, gave him the rank of Marshal and the title of Gazi. The Turkish army began its counter-offensive on 26 August 1922, destroyed most of the Greek army in the Commander-in-Chief Battle he directed on 30 August, entered Izmir on 9 September, and the Mudanya Armistice was signed on 11 October 1922.

heading.zh-Hant: 共和國、人民黨與總統任期
heading.en: The Republic, the People's Party and the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1923年9月9日，加齊穆斯塔法·凱末爾把護權協會（Müdafaa-i Hukuk Cemiyeti）改名為人民黨（Halk Fırkası）；大國民議會官方出版品稱此日為他宣布創黨之日。1923年10月29日大國民議會宣布共和國，並一致選他為首任總統，他此後連續四次當選，在任至1938年11月10日。1934年11月24日議會以第2587號法律授予他「阿塔圖克」姓氏。任內推行1933年五年工業計畫，並簽署1936年蒙特勒海峽公約。1938年11月10日他在伊斯坦堡多爾馬巴赫切宮逝世。
body.en: On 9 September 1923 Gazi Mustafa Kemal renamed the Defence of Rights association (Müdafaa-i Hukuk Cemiyeti) the People's Party (Halk Fırkası), the date an official TBMM publication treats as the day its founding by Mustafa Kemal was announced. On 29 October 1923 the Assembly proclaimed the Republic and unanimously elected him its first president; he was elected four times in a row and held the office until his death on 10 November 1938. Law no. 2587 of 24 November 1934 gave him the surname Atatürk. His presidency saw the 1933 Five-Year Industrial Plan and the 1936 Montreux Convention. He died at Dolmabahçe Palace on 10 November 1938.
